range.basis: Printed in FAO-56 Annex 8 for many annual crops («0.15 to 0.20 m»); D203 takes 0.20 m and declares 0.15 m as the sensitivity. Not an uncertainty interval of a measurement.

citation.reference: Allen, R.G., Pereira, L.S., Raes, D., Smith, M. (1998). Crop evapotranspiration - Guidelines for computing crop water requirements. FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56. FAO, Rome. ISBN 92-5-104219-5. Official HTML edition
citation.locator: Annex 8, text on the minimum rooting depth Zr min, the sentence «For many annual crops, Zr min can be estimated as 0.15 to 0.20 m.»
